name: Corporate Action Option 242
definition: Provides information about the corporate action option.

OptionNumber.name: Option Number
OptionNumber.definition: Number identifying the available corporate action options.

OptionType.name: Option Type
OptionType.definition: Specifies the corporate action options available to the account owner.

OptionFeatures.name: Option Features
OptionFeatures.definition: Specifies the features that may apply to a corporate action option.

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Account where financial instruments are maintained.

BlockChainAddressOrWallet.name: Block Chain Address Or Wallet
BlockChainAddressOrWallet.definition: Blockchain address or wallet where digital assets are maintained. This is the equivalent of safekeeping account for digital assets.

CashAccount.name: Cash Account
CashAccount.definition: Account on which a securities entry is made.

SafekeepingPlace.name: Safekeeping Place
SafekeepingPlace.definition: Location where the financial instruments are/will be safekept.

TotalEligibleBalance.name: Total Eligible Balance
TotalEligibleBalance.definition: Total balance of securities eligible for this corporate action event. The entitlement calculation is based on this balance.

ProtectBalance.name: Protect Balance
ProtectBalance.definition: Balance of securities which are in protect status in a CSD operating a protect cover service.

StatusQuantity.name: Status Quantity
StatusQuantity.definition: Quantity of securities that has been assigned the status indicated.

StatusCashAmount.name: Status Cash Amount
StatusCashAmount.definition: Amount of cash subscribed that has been assigned the status indicated.

SolicitationDealerFeeIndicator.name: Solicitation Dealer Fee Indicator
SolicitationDealerFeeIndicator.definition: Indicates whether there is a solicitation fee on the event. This fee is paid by the soliciting dealer.

OptionNumberRule.definition: For differentiation between options, the OptionNumber rather than the OptionType must be used, for example, in the case where two or more offers can be described by the same corporate action option code. Therefore, the OptionNumber value must be different for each option.

SafekeepingPlaceRule.definition: SafekeepingPlace must only be used by global custodians that allow their clients to specify where the securities are to be held, for example, in an ICSD account versus an account at the local CSD.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Ru.definition: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Ru.definition: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.

SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress3Ru.definition: Either SafekeepingAccount or BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be present but not both.
